The 2009 drivers' champion was Jenson Button. The documents cover only 8 of the 17 rounds, and Button won two of them: the Australian Grand Prix (Document 2) and the Malaysian Grand Prix (Document 8). He did not win any of the other six races shown, finishing 5th to 8th in those.

The documents don't include the remaining rounds, so this count is only a partial tally. Button's full-season win total isn't in the provided information, so the figure below counts only the documented races.

ANSWER: 2
